cxgn_statistics.obo: the SGNSTAT statistics ontology of Breedbase, copied unchanged
from the sgn repository (https://github.com/solgenomics/sgn, file ontology/cxgn_statistics.obo).
Breedbase loads its statistic terms from this file. It is used by breedtools to check
and choose the statistic of analysis results.
